parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current date.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

You can query data only from the last 90 days. This means `StartDate >= Now - 90`.
